scope: Source-only adjudication of chenditc/investment_data ts_index_weight as an exact point-in-time CSI1000 membership transport. No target/gap model executed.

evidence.tushare_official_frequency_description: index_weight is documented as monthly constituent and weight data; callers are advised to query from the first to last day of each month
evidence.upstream_ingestion: chenditc downloads Tushare index_weight in bounded date windows and stores returned trade_date without reconstructing official rebalance effective dates
evidence.qlib_interval_algorithm: membership signature is computed per returned trade_date; the first observed trade_date for a signature becomes the exported interval start
evidence.known_early_history_issue: public upstream issue reports only three CSI1000 lines over 2014-10-31 through 2015-05-28; no early-2015 backfill is scientifically allowed
evidence.frequency_irregularity_caveat: public Tushare issue reports historical index_weight frequency may vary across eras, so trade_date cannot be assumed to have one uniform semantic frequency

frozen_exact_PIT_gate.official_event: 2020-12-14 regular CSI1000 adjustment including 19 STAR Market securities
frozen_exact_PIT_gate.requirement: the new membership signature must be directly observed on the official effective date; a later monthly/sparse snapshot is insufficient

adjudication.reason: The candidate has useful historical membership snapshots but its documented monthly/sparse upstream semantics and exporter algorithm do not prove that signature interval starts equal official effective dates. The frozen exact-effective-date gate has not been satisfied.
permitted_use: source-health comparison against an independently reconstructed official PIT series
forbidden_use: blindly extending a monthly signature backward to an official rebalance date

next_source_path: reconstruct PIT membership from an independently verified base snapshot plus official CSI regular and temporary adjustment events; validate every event boundary against at least one independent membership interval source
